input.rationale: Section 4 covers only term, notice and the Termination Payment; nothing in the Agreement (including the confidentiality, survival and export-file provisions) requires HDI to provide transition assistance or to return, export or delete the Company's site content, user information or customer and order data on expiry or termination. With HDI hosting the Site and holding our data, the absence of any exit mechanic fails even the fallback (90 days of assistance plus export within 30 days), so we insert a new Section 4.3 at the preferred position.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion obligations in Section 4
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit provisions, so we have added transition assistance for up to six months at HDI's then-current rates plus return of our data within 30 days in a machine-readable format and certified deletion thereafter. We can accept 90 days of assistance with the 30-day export as a fallback.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return to the Company all Content, user information and customer and order data of the Company ("Company Data") in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Company Data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
